diagnosis: Local repo is on feature/terrayield-aays-integration; repeated git pull --rebase origin main is blocked by untracked/unstaged files, so the runner input script never materializes locally and -File fails because the ps1 path does not exist.
fix: Do not pull, checkout, or stash. Fetch the feature branch and materialize only the needed ps1 file with git show origin/feature/terrayield-aays-integration:path > local path, then run that file.
manual_powershell_reason: A single local command is needed only to materialize and run the feature-branch-safe script; no local stdout should be pasted back.
